entities.summary: Ronald Fred Seikaly is a former NBA star, real estate developer, and internationally acclaimed DJ and music producer. The first-ever draft pick in Miami Heat history, Seikaly became one of the best centers in the NBA—and one of the earliest internationally born players to make an impact on American basketball.
